sentences.text: Accordingly, on 1st September 2021, one vehicle i.e  Ashok Leyland Truck bearing No.MH-20 EL-5849 was intercepted.
The  applicant No.1 was the driver and owner on the said vehicle and the  applicant No.2 was accompanying the applicant No.1.
It was found that th  applicants were carrying prohibited material in the said vehicle i.e. Hi  Pan Masala valued at Rs.4,29,002/- and Royal 717 Scented Tobacco valued  at Rs.2,31,003/-.
Accordingly, the said articles were seized by the poli  and the aforesaid C.R. was registered.
4. Learned Counsel for the applicants submits that prima facie  taking the case as it stands, no offence as alleged under Section 328 of  I.P.C is disclosed qua the applicants.
He submits that as far as the oth  sections are concerned, all the sections are bailable.
5. It appears that the applicants were transporting the said  prohibited material/articles.
Whether or not the offence under Section 3  of the I.P.C. is made out or not, is a matter which will be decided by t  trial Court.
The statement of the learned counsel for the applicants tha  applicants have no antecedents is accepted.
The applicants are in custod  since 2nd September 2021.

Accordingly, the application is allowed and  applicants are enlarged on bail, on the following terms and conditions:-
 ORDER (i) The applicants be enlarged on bail, on executing PR Bond in the sum of Rs. 25,000/- each with one or two local sureties in the like amount;

It is made clear that the observations made herein are prima facie, and the trial Court shall decide the case on its own merits, in accordance with law, uninfluenced by the observations made in this order.
